propositions: Project code-review criteria's `applies_to` field is stored but never validated or read at dispatch time, causing criteria to run on all reviews regardless of which files changed.
The dispatch path in `gate_dispatch.py:427-447` filters only on criterion_id prefix and exec type, ignoring `applies_to` and never receiving changed-files context.

Shape validation for `applies_to` is absent from `_validate_routing_entry`, allowing malformed values (non-list, non-string elements, bare strings) to silently narrow to `[]` instead of failing loudly.

Project criteria bypass the workflow's membership gating by appending after `req.criteria` rather than participating in `when:` expressions, and `OVERLAY_IDS` enum excludes project ids so they never participate in built-in glob firing.
Plan-review has a working counterpart (`registry.project_trigger_fires`, `applies_at` validation, `file_impact_globs`), but code-review has no equivalent gating mechanism.
The semantic collision on empty `applies_to` (built-in means escalation-only; project means ungated/always-run) must be documented to prevent misuse.
